newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish Eregli exceeds H1 output, sale targets.
newsitem.headline: Turkish Eregli exceeds H1 output, sale targets.

text.p: Turkey's largely state-owned and leading flat steel maker Eregli ve Demir Celik Fabrikalari said it surpassed its production and sale targets in the first six months of this year.

Eregli produced 1,430,000 tonnes of flat steel in the first six months, five percent above the programmed output, and sold 1,427,000 tonnes of flat steel, exceeding the first-half target by seven percent, the company said in a statement.

Eregli aims to sell 2.85 million tonnes of products this year, including 500,000 tonnes of exports. Its 1996 output was a record 2,621,000 tonnes and sales were 2,517,000 tonnes, including 502,000 tonnes exported.
